newsitem.title: USA: Crop Growers stake sold by Spellman group.
newsitem.headline: Crop Growers stake sold by Spellman group.

text.p: A group including Kramer Spellman L.P., a Fort Lee, N.J., investment firm, said Wednesdasy it sold its stake in Crop Growers Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 805,700 common shares on March 18 at prices ranging from $9.782 to $9.84 per share.

Crop Growers, based in Great Falls, Mt., markets and services federal multi-peril crop insurance and crop hail insurance for third party insurance companies and its own insurance company subsidiaries.
